name: Z5
summary: A.O. Smith Z5 is a stylish RO water purifier with 100% RO + Silver Charged Membrane Technology (SCMT) that delivers Baby-Safe, purified drinking water.
intro: The A.O. Smith Z5 is a premium RO water purifier featuring 100% RO + Silver Charged Membrane Technology (SCMT) for Baby-Safe drinking water. Its Alkaline Min-Tech filter enriches water with essential minerals and balances pH for healthier, better-tasting water. Designed for wall-mounted or tabletop installation, it includes a digital display.
